content: Dr. Namgyal and Director CDS Dr. Suman Rijal from WHO SEARO were involved in the process. The entire process was supervised by Dr. Sunil Bahl, who serves as the Coordinator for COVAX, Immunization, and Vaccine Development. Dr. Sudhir Khanal from IVD/CDS WHO SEARO led the coordination and development of the technical document in collaboration with Dr. Sudhir Joshi, also from IVD/CDS WHO SEARO. WHO Consultant Dr. Lalit Kant played a pivotal role in updating the technical content of the document. The document also benefited from the expert contributions of participants from the Regional Workshop held from June 13–16, 2022, in Dhaka. This workshop focused on reviewing progress toward measles-rubella and other priority vaccine-preventable disease (VPD) surveillance, as well as outbreak preparedness and response in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Participants included National EPI Programme Managers, VPD Surveillance Officers from Member States, WHO country office staff, UNICEF representatives, and other external collaborators. WHO Headquarters staff, including Dr. Anindya Bose and Dr. Heidi Soeters, reviewed the draft surveillance standard document and provided technical inputs. From WHO SEARO, contributions were made by Dr. Jayantha Liyanage, Dr. Sigrun Roesel, Dr. Emmanuel Njambe, Dr. Lucky Sangal, Dr. Pankaj Bhatnagar, Ms. Uttara Aggarwal, Mr. Sharifuzzaman, Dr. Rajendra Bohara, Dr. Ariful Islam, Dr. Tanbir Islam, Dr. Subramanya Balakuntla Pattabhiramaiah, Dr. Ratnesh Murugan, Dr. Stephen Chacko, Dr. Paba Palihawadana, Dr. Aishath Thimna Latheef, Dr. Balwinder Chawla, Dr. Khaing Khaing Gyi, Dr. Vinod Bura, Dr. Rahul Pradhan, Dr. Pasang Rai, Dr. Preshila Samaraweera, Ms. Aree Moungsookjareoun, and Dr. Sudath Peiris. From UNICEF, Christopher Gregory provided inputs and coordinated contributions from the UNICEF team to various sections of the document. From the US CDC, Dr. Ahmed Kassem and Dr. Michelle Morales contributed to different sections of the document and coordinated inputs from various teams within the US CDC.
